# squatch-dsp

> A small real-time C++17 sound engine for guitar effects: the Block/Arena/parameter core, limiter, noise gate, RBJ EQ and the Squatch Tuner, with thin hosts (JACK, a web page, WebAssembly in the browser). No fetched dependencies; make test runs ASan/UBSan/TSan suites including an allocation and lock watch.

110 tracked files; source by language (file count): C++ 64, JavaScript 10, Python 2, C 1.

Links are repository-relative paths. [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) inlines every linked file in this order. Both files are generated by project-kit `llms/generate.py` from tracked files; do not edit them by hand - the drift gate (`generate.py check`) fails when they are stale.

## Start here

- [squatch-dsp](README.md): A small real-time sound engine in C++17 for guitar effects: each block is written once and runs on a Raspberry Pi, a microcontroller, in a browser and in desktop plugins, with a thin host for each.
- [Contributing to squatch-dsp](CONTRIBUTING.md): Thank you for helping.
- [squatch-dsp roadmap](ROADMAP.md): Pi, on a microcontroller pedal, in a browser and in a desktop plugin, because it is the same code.

## Docs

- [.github/pull_request_template.md](.github/pull_request_template.md)
- [Squatch Tuner](blocks/tuner/README.md): A guitar and bass tuner core that reads a string to a tenth of a cent, built as a software strobe.
- [Squatch Tuner: measured results](blocks/tuner/RESULTS.md): Measured on 2026-09-23 on an Apple M1 Max (clang 21, `-O3`, no fast-math) with the code in this commit.

- [blocks/tuner/results/poly.md](blocks/tuner/results/poly.md): poly reading minus the mono reading of the same pluck alone, RMS c (p95 |diff|) [valid %]
- [blocks/tuner/results/real-variants.md](blocks/tuner/results/real-variants.md): Real DI: 275 notes that ring at least 1.5 s, from 2 file(s); each algorithm runs continuously over the whole file; re-pitch test +7.0 c.
- [blocks/tuner/results/real.md](blocks/tuner/results/real.md): Real DI: 275 notes that ring at least 1.5 s, from 2 file(s); each algorithm runs continuously over the whole file; re-pitch test +7.0 c.
- [blocks/tuner/results/synth.md](blocks/tuner/results/synth.md): Synthetic matrix: 12 notes E1..E6 x 8 trials, detune uniform ±50 c, 48 kHz input.
